messages:
emma: Thinking about a new metric for the cost dashboard — 'net token cost by service'. idea: show gross tokens, cache hits saved, and model-unit cost all in one row so PMs can see where caching actually moves the needle. thoughts?

raj: agree in principle. key Q: how do we attribute cache savings to a route vs shared prefix cache? need deterministic rules or estimates.

sasha: +1. telemetry already emits `request.tokens`, `cache.hits`, and `model.identifier`. we can compute `net = request.tokens - cache.hits` at rollup time. example SQL I hacked: 
```sql
SELECT service, model, sum(request_tokens) as gross, sum(cache_hits) as saved, sum(request_tokens)-sum(cache_hits) as net, model_unit_rate
FROM telemetry_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN $start AND $end
GROUP BY service, model, model_unit_rate;
```
This gives a per-(service,model) row.

alec: that works but watch out for double-counting with routing fallbacks. if a request falls back to cheaper model, tokens are emitted for both attempts? we should only count final served tokens. maybe add `attempt=final` filter. also pre-aggregate by day to keep dashboard snappy.

maria: UX notes: we need an out-of-the-box toggle for "include cache savings" vs "show gross tokens". PMs will want to flip between both. also add per-route SLA filters (p95 latency buckets) so they can correlate cost to latency.

emma: @sasha can we add a tag to telemetry for `cache attribution` that indicates whether the cache hit is prefix-level or route-level? even a best-effort label will help splits.

sasha: yeah I can emit `cache.scope = 'route'|'prefix'|'global'` next deploy. will need to update ingestion mapping and the rollup job.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: analytics/telemetry-service v3.8.0 deployed to prod (sha: a1b2c3).

raj: once we have that scope tag, we should run a short A/B: compute attribution both ways and show delta column in dashboard so teams understand sensitivity. small sample window first.

alec: ops note: if we add daily pre-aggregates we should store both `gross_tokens` and `cache_saved_tokens` as ints and keep `net_tokens` derived at read time to avoid drift. also add an index on (service,model,date).

maria: for rollout UX: default view should be net cost per 1000 requests with sparkline and a mini breakdown modal that shows contribution by cache scope. add export CSV button.

emma: sounds like an action list: 1) sasha emits cache.scope tag (PR by EOD) 2) alec to add pre-agg schema + index 3) dashboard: show gross/saved/net & toggle + SLA filter (maria) 4) run A/B attribution test (raj). I'll open cards in our board. :thumbsup:

sasha: will do. opening a PR now.

emma: thanks everyone — moving to product board.
